about: Single numbers that shape a match and the hub. Read by key.

rows.meaning: most real players one room (world) takes (creator: 16, four full squads; Minecraft's own limit for a shared world is 8)
a full 100-player battle royale: bots fill every place real players do not
a simulated bot becomes a real bot entity when a player is this close
a real bot with no player this close goes back to being simulated
simulated bots move towards the safe zone at this speed
simulated bots this close may fight
chance per second that a close simulated pair fights to an elimination
most real bot entities at once (performance)
once EVERY player in the hub stands on the same mode portal; anyone stepping off (or onto another portal) cancels it
the Battle Bus flies this far below the world's height limit (it IS the height limit of the match)
Battle Bus speed along its straight route over the island (about 70 s across)
the route starts and ends this far INSIDE the first circle, so the bus is never in the storm
doors stay shut this long after boarding (can't jump yet)
match 1 centre distance from the hub (fresh terrain)
each later match moves this far along +X (fresh island)
the island: storm circle radius when the bus leaves (bigger storm, creator request)
a scattered loot chest is the rare blue chest instead of the gold one (better loot: legendary / mythic weapons, Chug Jug)
a custom building's loot chest is the rare blue chest instead of the gold one
hold the interact key (F) at a closed chest this long to search it: the lid opens and its loot pops out (creator: Fortnite's chests); bots take as long
how close (from your eyes) a chest has to be, roughly in front of you, to search it

damage a parked car takes before it's wrecked; it adds up and stays between hits (creator). A pickaxe hit does carDurability / the harvest sheet's h_car maxBlocks (600 / 6 = 100) and still gives h_car perBlock metal; a gun shot does its own damage (rarity included). The car looks more damaged at 450, 300 and 150 left

custom buildings on each island (shacks, watchtowers, supply depots, ruins, parking lots full of cars and container yards: those two break for metal), each with a loot chest; built as their area loads (was 16, creator: slightly more common)
every island gets at least this many of each kind of custom building (creator)
every island gets at least this many parking lots, on spots flat enough for the big lot (creator)
random spots tried for the custom buildings: spares for spots too steep, wet or close to another building
candidate island centres checked for oceans/beaches/snow before giving up and using the best one
fastest fall while skydiving (steer with WASD)
horizontal speed while skydiving
build grid: one Fortnite tile is this many blocks across
build grid: one storey (wall and ramp height)
farthest a piece can be placed from the builder
Space opens or closes the glider at any height during the drop; if the player never opened it, it opens by itself once at this height above the ground (no fall damage either way)
fall speed under the glider
forward speed under the glider
loot chests placed inside the first circle (placed 1 per tick while the bus flies)
loot entries per gold chest (each gun comes with its ammo)
a bot that can see a player this close may go after them at any time (not only after being shot); farther players are left alone
each half-second, chance that a bot busy with another bot switches to a visible player within botPlayerRange (bots still fight each other too)
pickaxe hit on an opponent (players and gunless bots)
after the bus leaves, bots hold fire this long (creator: 0, bots attack players no matter what during a round)
bot gun damage multiplier (players land unarmed)
Fortnite health
Fortnite shield
most players in one party (creator: a 5th can't join; Squads never has 5)
a party invite can be accepted this long
Duos and up: a knocked fighter bleeds out over this long the first time in a match
each further knock in the same match bleeds this much faster (30 s, 20 s, 15 s...)
a knocked fighter crawls at this fraction of walking speed
a teammate holds the interact key (F) this long next to a knocked teammate to revive them
how close the reviver has to stay
health after being revived (no shield)
an eliminated teammate's reboot card can be picked up (and used) this long
hold the interact key (F) at a reboot van this long to bring back every teammate whose card you carry
how close to a reboot van's middle you have to stand
reboot vans on each island (team modes only)
a van can't be used again for this long after a reboot
rebooted players drop from this high above the van, with their glider
out of a fight, a bot stays about this close to its team (a real teammate first)
after the winner is decided, before everyone returns to the hub
height of the hub baseplate
below this in the hub you respawn at your checkpoint
once the circle is this small (or 3 teams are left) simulated bots stop looting and hunt the nearest enemy team
this long without a bot elimination and the two closest simulated enemies fight it out (a match always ends)
once the storm has closed completely its damage per second rises by this every 10 s
a shooting-range round, from your first hit: its score is a round score (best round and bullseyes unlock emotes and gliders)
